text:
yasmin: accepted the GitHub invite but when I go to https://github.com/orgs/redwood I get a 404 and can't see private repos. clone attempts give 403 over HTTPS and Permission denied (publickey) over SSH.
ira: did you accept while signed into your work account? sometimes a personal session makes GH show 404 even after accept.
yasmin: i think so. I use GitHub Desktop and it opened the embedded browser to accept. maybe that used my personal account.
people-ops: onboarding-note: GitHub Desktop can reuse cached credentials. Quick steps: 1) sign out of github.com in browser, 2) open incognito, 3) sign in as work account, 4) visit org page and click "Authorize SSO" (redirects to Okta).
yasmin: incognito showed the org and an "Authorize SSO" button. clicked it, approved in Okta. gh CLI now says SSO: authorized.
desk-bot: desk-bot: detected SSO authorization for yasmin. Please restart GitHub Desktop and run `gh auth refresh` in terminal.
yasmin: restarted Desktop, now can see repos but SSH still failed. `ssh -T git@github.com` -> Permission denied (publickey).
ira: check Settings -> SSH and GPG keys on your GitHub profile. If the key is on your personal account you'll get that error. Also run `ssh-add -l` to see if agent has keys loaded.
yasmin: ssh key was on my personal account indeed. moved it to work account, ran `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and `ssh -T` now returns the greeting. clone/push working.
people-ops: thanks for the writeup. we'll add a short checklist: avoid accepting invites in embedded app browsers, verify work email primary, try incognito if you hit 404, and confirm SSH key is on the work account. welcome aboard, yasmin :tada:
